text: KEEP stands. The add trigger I ratify is close_above:bar_high on D: a daily close back above the red bar's high. My adds come only on strength, when the trade proves me right, 50/30/20 (C16, C30); reclaim:ma_20 would add into a dip, which my method does not do. BULLISH_BOS, ret_63d 14.08, rs_rank_pct 85.1, cmf positive. The 1.4x volume and 5pct conditions are no steps in my deck; printed I can live with them. Exit armed: trade under bar_low, the red candle's low (C14), or a daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d).
